---
name: Task or proposal
about: Propose a bounded improvement, investigation, documentation change, or maintenance task.
---

## Problem

<!-- Explain the current limitation and why addressing it matters. -->

## Scope

<!--
State the intended outcome and important exclusions. An implementation idea
may be included, but label it as a proposal unless a linked maintainer decision
requires it. Do not turn this issue into a file-by-file coding prescription.
-->

## Acceptance criteria

<!--
List a few observable outcomes that would make this task complete.
Task checkboxes are appropriate for real outcomes, not generic assurances.
For an investigation, name the questions to answer and the expected record;
do not promise a particular finding. Do not invent performance thresholds,
compatibility exceptions, or other policy changes.
-->

## Validation plan

<!--
Describe how completion could be checked, using existing tests or procedures
where appropriate. This is a plan, not a report of checks already performed.
Keep it proportional to the scope; current repository verification policy wins.
-->

## Related work

<!--
Link the parent issue, direct dependencies, relevant findings, and any explicit
maintainer decision. Distinguish blockers from merely related work.
Write "None" if nothing applies. Filing this issue is not approval to implement it.
-->
